verdict.rationale: iTerm2 documents a native tmux integration via "tmux -CC". tmux sessions open as normal iTerm2 windows, keep running when iTerm2 quits or the ssh connection drops, and "tmux -CC attach" reopens them in the same state. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the tmux integration (no community evidence addresses it), and no explicit evidence about running plain tmux inside the terminal outside control mode.
